# [reference] Xterra and Frontier parts interchange

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Swap the front brake assembly from a Nissan Z32 and select either 4-piston calipers or standard units. [t1132]

[Partial] Install a Z32 brake assembly and mount a 300mm R50 Pathfinder rotor on the existing spindle. [t1132]

Fit a Z32 brake assembly onto an Xterra using the stock 2000-2004 spindle and install a sleeve on the caliper bolts. [t1132]

Replace the early model master cylinder with a late model (2003-2004) unit. [t1132]

[Partial] Install a larger bore master cylinder from a '99 Dodge Ram 1500. [t1132]

[Partial] Adapt the front brake line by installing an M10x1.0 bubble flare to inverted flare adapter. [t1132]

Adapt the rear brake line by installing an M12x1.0 bubble flare to M10x1.0 inverted flare adapter. [t1132]
